steps.name: build_model
steps.code:
# Mounting plate with a bossed bore
plate_l, plate_w, plate_t = 60, 40, 8
boss_d, boss_h, bore_d = 20, 15, 8
hole_d, inset = 5, 8
with BuildPart() as plate:
    Box(plate_l, plate_w, plate_t)
    with Locations((0, 0, plate_t / 2)):
        Cylinder(boss_d / 2, boss_h, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
    Hole(bore_d / 2)
    with Locations((-plate_l/2 + inset, -plate_w/2 + inset), (plate_l/2 - inset, -plate_w/2 + inset),
                   (-plate_l/2 + inset, plate_w/2 - inset), (plate_l/2 - inset, plate_w/2 - inset)):
        Hole(hole_d / 2)
    fillet(plate.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z).group_by(Axis.X)[0] + plate.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z).group_by(Axis.X)[-1], 4)
boss_top = plate.part.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1]
plate_part = plate.part.chamfer(1, None, [boss_top.edges().filter_by(GeomType.CIRCLE).sort_by(SortBy.RADIUS)[-1]])
result = {"Plate": plate_part}
steps.result: Model OK: 1 body, 18 faces, total volume=21987.7mm³
